question: What is the 'Communion of Saints' and what three groups does it encompass?

choices.A: The Church Triumphant (saints in heaven), the Church Suffering (souls in purgatory), and the Church Militant (the living faithful on earth)
choices.B: Catholics, Eastern Orthodox, and Anglicans who share Apostolic Succession
choices.C: Those who have received First Communion, Confirmation, and Holy Orders
choices.D: The pope, the cardinals, and the bishops

teaching.title: Communion of Saints — Three Groups
teaching.body: The Communion of Saints (communio sanctorum) refers to the spiritual solidarity of all the holy ones united in Christ. It has two meanings: a communion in holy things (the sacraments, faith) and a communion of holy persons. The three groups: (1) Church Triumphant — saints fully glorified in heaven; (2) Church Suffering — souls being purified in purgatory; (3) Church Militant — the living faithful still fighting sin on earth. All three are in mystical communion: the living pray for the souls in purgatory; the saints intercede for the living; the whole Church is united under Christ the head.
